caption: The drawing shows four vertically oriented, cylindrical wooden sticks or branches arranged side by side against a plain, light-colored background. Each stick has animal carvings: the first and second sticks from the left feature a snake coiled around their lower parts, while the upper sections display what appears to be rodent or mammal figures climbing upward. The third and fourth sticks from the left display only rodent or mammal figures in various climbing poses. All carvings and the wood are rendered in shades of brown and tan, with the animal shapes slightly lighter in color compared to the darker, textured appearance of the wooden surfaces on which they are carved. The objects are evenly spaced, with no other elements in the composition.
title: Walking Stick
